definitions.explanation: Hanging laundry to dry inside the house rather than outdoors. Common during rainy season, winter, or in apartments without balconies.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}は{室内干|しつないぼ}しにする。
examples.english: On rainy days, I dry the laundry indoors.

examples.japanese: {室内干|しつないぼ}しだと{乾|かわ}きにくい。
examples.english: Laundry is hard to dry when hung indoors.

examples.japanese: {梅雨|つゆ}の{時期|じき}は{室内干|しつないぼ}しが{続|つづ}くので、{除湿機|じょしつき}が{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: During the rainy season, indoor drying continues for days, so a dehumidifier is essential.

notes:
Hanging laundry to dry inside rather than outdoors. Especially common during {梅雨|つゆ} (rainy season), in winter, and in apartments without balconies.

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of {室内|しつない} (indoors) + {干|ほ}し (drying).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {室内干|しつないぼ}し{用|よう}: for indoor drying (detergent, rack, etc.)
- {部屋干|へやぼ}し: room drying (casual synonym)
- {生乾|なまがわ}きの{臭|にお}い: musty smell from incomplete drying

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外干|そとぼ}し / {天日干|てんぴぼ}し: sun-drying outdoors

TIPS:
Using a {除湿機|じょしつき} (dehumidifier), {扇風機|せんぷうき} (fan), or {部屋干|へやぼ}し{用|よう}{洗剤|せんざい} (indoor-drying detergent) helps prevent odor.
